interface.longDescription: Files, searches and terminal work, with selected Codex conversations, skills and compatible MCP tools. A separate Subchat MCP uses a dedicated headless Chrome login and HTTP reads; generation and remote mutations are not exposed in that Plugin server. Public alpha. ChatGPT requires HTTPS setup; macOS GUI requires a separately installed compatible Peekaboo MCP. Hosting is not included.
